name: Deadly Demise 2D6
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here 2D6).

name: Deadly Demise D6+2
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here D6+2).

name: Deadly Demise D6+6
summary: Deadly Demise X: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 6, units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds (here D6+6).

name: Firing Deck 11
summary: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, up to X (here 11) embarked models each lend it one of their ranged weapons (not one-shot) for its attacks; those models' units cannot shoot again this phase.

name: Scouts 7"
summary: Scouts X: before the battle, a unit wholly with this ability can set up anywhere in your deployment zone from reserves, or make a scout move of up to X" (here 7") ending more than 8" from all enemy units.

name: Acrobatic
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Acrobatic Grace
summary: This unit has Stealth, and melee attacks that target it take -1 to hit.

name: Aethersails
summary: Each time this model Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 6" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

name: Aethersense (Psychic)
summary: Enemy Reinforcement units cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

name: Agile
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move over other non-Titanic models and terrain 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

name: Arcane Cover
summary: If this Fortification blocks visibility to a model targeted by a ranged attack, that model gains Benefit of Cover against the attack.

name: Aspect Shrine Token
summary: Once per battle per token this unit has, change the result of a Hit or Wound roll for a non-Character model in this unit to an unmodified 6, consuming one token.

name: ASPECT TRAINING
summary: While this model leads a Howling Banshees unit, it has the Fights First ability; while leading a Striking Scorpions unit, it has Infiltrators, Scouts 7", and Stealth.

name: Assured Destruction
summary: Ranged attacks by models in this unit against a Monster or Vehicle can re-roll the Hit roll, the Wound roll, and the Damage roll.

name: AVATAR OF THE WHISPERING GOD
summary: If your army includes this model, it cannot also include any Epic Hero units excluding Ynnari, and vice versa.

name: Bladestorm
summary: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability while targeting an enemy unit within half range.

name: Blitz
summary: Once per battle, before this model's Normal move, add 2D6" to its Move characteristic and 3 Attacks to its melee weapons until end of turn.

name: Blur of Movement
summary: This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Bonesinger
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Wraith Construct or Asuryani Vehicle unit, unless leading a unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Branching Fates (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, once per phase change the result of a Hit, Wound, or Damage roll made for a model in that unit to an unmodified 6.

name: Bringer of the True Death
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in that unit can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Burning Lance
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 6" to the Range characteristic of Melta weapons equipped by models in that unit.

name: Cegorach’s Favour
summary: Melee attacks this model makes can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Channeller Stones
summary: Once per turn, the first failed saving throw for the bearer's unit has the attack's Damage characteristic changed to 0.

name: Choreographer of War
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit can Pile-in or Consolidate up to 6" instead of 3", without needing to end closer to the closest enemy model.

name: Cloudbreakers
summary: When this model Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 6" to its Move characteristic until end of phase.

name: Cloudstrider
summary: While leading a unit, that unit can be removed and placed in Strategic Reserves at the end of the opponent's turn if not in Engagement Range; on Deep Strike it may arrive over 6" from all enemies but cannot then charge.

name: Cluster Caltrops
summary: Each time you roll a D6 for the bearer while resolving this unit's Eviscerating Fly-by ability, you can re-roll it.

name: CORSAIRS
summary: A model with the Leader ability that could attach to a related unit can attach to this unit instead.

name: Crewed Platform
summary: When the last non-platform model in this unit is destroyed, any remaining Heavy Weapon Platform models in it are also destroyed.

name: Cruel Amusement
summary: When this model shoots, choose Ignores Cover, Precision, or Sustained Hits 3 for its shrieker cannon to have until end of phase.

name: Cry of the Wind
summary: When this model is set up on the battlefield, until end of turn its ranged attacks score a Critical Hit on any successful unmodified Hit roll.

name: Crystal Matrix
summary: When this model shoots, re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll among those attacks.

name: Crystalline Targeting
summary: After this unit shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit, once per turn; until end of phase, friendly Aeldari attacks against it get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: D-rift
summary: When this model targets with its D-impaler, roll a D6 for the target and each unit within 3" of it; on a 5+ that unit takes D3 mortal wounds after this model's attacks resolve.

name: Dance of Death
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, choose one buff for this unit until end of phase: re-roll a Hit roll of 1, add 1 to the Wound roll, or -1 to the Hit roll of attacks against it.

name: Death is Not Enough
summary: After this model shoots, pick a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit it hit; it must take a Battle-shock test, with -1 if a model in it was destroyed by those attacks.

name: DEPLOYMENT
summary: Setup rule for a multi-part model or Fortification: its parts must be placed in the arrangement its datasheet specifies, and are then treated either as a single model or as separate units, depending on the datasheet.

name: Devastating Assault
summary: Effect varies by model: either one enemy unit hit by this model's shooting must take a Battle-shock test, or this model's melee weapons gain Devastating Wounds until the end of the turn after it makes a Charge move.

name: Diviner of Futures
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, gain 1 Command Point.

name: Doom (Psychic)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 18"; until your next Command phase, friendly Aeldari attacks against it get +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Empowered by Death
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, if this model's unit is below Starting Strength, models in it have the Fights First ability until end of phase.

name: Empyric Ambush
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it used its teleport-style movement ability.

name: Ethereal Form
summary: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit, it regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Eviscerating Fly-by
summary: Each time this unit ends a Normal move, select one non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit it moved over: roll one D6 per model in this unit, each 4+ dealing that enemy 1 mortal wound.

name: Extreme Mobility
summary: When this unit makes any type of move, ignore vertical distance when determining total distance moved.

name: Face of Death
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; that unit must take a Battle-shock test with a -1 penalty.

name: Faolchú
summary: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Fated Hero
summary: At the start of the battle, choose Infantry, Monster, Mounted, or Vehicle; attacks this model makes against a unit with that keyword re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

name: Flawless Poise
summary: This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Fleet of Foot
summary: This unit can perform its Fade Back manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token, without limit or interaction with other units doing the same.

name: Flickerjump
summary: When this unit is selected to make a Normal move, it may instead gain a 24" Move but cannot then charge this turn; at end of phase roll a D6 per model, each 1 dealing 1 mortal wound to the unit.

name: Flip Belt
summary: When the bearer's unit makes any type of move, ignore vertical distance when determining the total distance the bearer can be moved.

name: Fog of Dreams (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack from within 18".

name: Forceshield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Fury of the Void (Psychic)
summary: After this model's unit shoots, pick an enemy unit hit by its named weapon; until end of turn, friendly Aeldari attacks against it get +1 Strength.

name: Grav-talon
summary: The bearer's melee weapons have the Lance ability.

name: Grenade Pack Flyover
summary: Once per turn, when this unit deploys or ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, target a visible enemy within 8": roll one D6 per SWOOPING HAWKS model (max 6 wounds), 1 mortal wound per 4+; blocks Explosives Stratagem on this unit that turn.

name: Guide (Psychic)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 18", once per unit per turn; until your next Command phase friendly Aeldari attacks against it get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Hallucinogen Grenades
summary: At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, grant a visible friendly Aeldari Infantry unit within 36" the Stealth ability until end of phase.

name: Hand of Asuryan
summary: Once per battle, when this model shoots, its named weapon gains Damage 3, Anti-Infantry 5+, and Devastating Wounds until end of phase.

name: Harassment Fire
summary: After this unit shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; until your next turn that unit's attacks suffer -1 to the Hit roll.

name: Harvester of Souls
summary: While this model leads a unit and all its attacks target the same enemy unit, roll a D6 for that unit and each other enemy unit within 3"; each 5+ deals D3 mortal wounds after attacks resolve.

name: Herald of Ynnead
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, pick an enemy unit within Engagement Range; until end of phase friendly Aeldari attacks against it can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Hero of Iyanden
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

name: Horrify (Psychic)
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Hunter Unseen
summary: This model's unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack from within 12".

name: Indomitable Strength of Will
summary: While this model leads a unit, each time you spend a Battle Focus token for that unit's Agile Manoeuvre, roll a D6: on a 3+ regain 1 Battle Focus token.

name: Inescapable Accuracy
summary: Ranged attacks by models in this unit may ignore modifiers to their Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

name: Inevitable Death
summary: Once per opponent's turn, when a friendly AELDARI unit is destroyed while this model is on the battlefield, relocate this model near that unit's last model, outside Engagement Range, keeping its move eligibility.

name: Interceptor
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against a unit that can Fly get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Into the Foe
summary: If a unit disembarks from this transport before it moves, it is eligible to charge this turn even though it Advanced.

name: Lanced Obliteration
summary: If this model's twin weapon destroys an enemy model with a Deadly Demise ability, that ability triggers on a D6 of 4+ instead of only a 6.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: After this model's Normal move, pick a non-Monster, non-Vehicle unit it moved over and roll six D6; each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to it.

name: Linked Fire
summary: This weapon can measure range and visibility from another friendly model of the same type visible to the bearer, but then only makes 1 attack.

name: Lithe Embarkation
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if this TRANSPORT has no embarked models, one eligible friendly YNNARI INFANTRY unit of 6 or fewer models wholly within 6" and outside Engagement Range can embark, even the turn it disembarked.

name: Malevolent Souls
summary: If a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase, roll a D6: on a 3+ it fights after the attacker's unit finishes, then is removed.

name: Mandiblasters
summary: Melee attacks by models in this unit that made a Charge move this turn score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

name: Mindshock Pod (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, its Battle-shock and Leadership tests suffer -1.

name: Misfortune (Psychic)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 18", once per unit per turn; until your next Command phase its attacks suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Mistshield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Molten Form
summary: Attacks allocated to this model have their Damage characteristic halved.

name: Monofilament Snare
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit hit by its named weapon; until your next turn, each time that unit moves, roll a D6 per model, each 1 dealing 1 mortal wound.

name: Monofilament Web
summary: After this model shoots, if a hit was scored with its named weapon, until your next turn that unit's Move characteristic is reduced by 2" and its Charge rolls suffer -2.

name: No Escape
summary: Each time a non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability Falls Back, it must take a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if Battle-shocked.

name: Overlord
summary: While this model leads a unit, its attacks can re-roll a Wound roll of 1; if that unit is below Starting Strength, it can re-roll any Wound roll instead.

name: Path of Command
summary: Once per battle round, when this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's Command Point cost by 1.

name: PATH OF DAMNATION
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Path of the Outcast
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this model and it is not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Phantasm Grenade Launcher
summary: The bearer's unit gains the Grenades keyword.

name: Piratical Hero
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks by models in it gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability and +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Piratical Raiders
summary: At the start of the battle, choose an enemy unit; this unit's weapons gain Lethal Hits and Precision while targeting it.

name: Point-blank Devastation
summary: When this model's named weapon targets a unit within half range, re-roll the dice used to determine the number of attacks.

name: Polychromatic Camouflage
summary: This unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack from within 18".

name: Prince of Corsairs
summary: After deployment, if this unit (or its TRANSPORT) is on the battlefield, select up to three AELDARI units and redeploy them, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal limit.

name: Protect (Psychic)
summary: While a Farseer leads this unit, attacks that target it suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Psychic Communion (Psychic)
summary: Each time this model shoots, its Destructor weapon gets +1 Attacks and +1 Strength per other friendly AELDARI PSYKER within 6" (max +2), until end of phase.

name: Psychic Guidance
summary: While within 12" of a friendly Aeldari Psyker, this unit gains Leadership 6+ and +1 to the Hit roll, or improved Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill for a single model.

name: Psytronome Shaper
summary: In your Command phase, a friendly Wraith Construct or Asuryani Vehicle model within 3" of this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Raid and Run
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if eligible to fight, this unit can move up to D3+3": a Normal move if not in Engagement Range, otherwise a Fall Back move.

name: Rapid Embarkation
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if this TRANSPORT has no embarked models, one friendly HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit of 6 or fewer models wholly within 6" and outside Engagement Range can embark, even the turn it disembarked.

name: Reaper of Souls
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks by models in that unit get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Reaver Band
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move within 8" of this unit and it is not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Reavers of the Void
summary: Attacks by models in this unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or re-roll the Hit roll entirely against a target within range of an objective marker.

name: Reborn Mastermind
summary: Once per battle round, when this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's Command Point cost by 1.

name: Reckless Abandon
summary: You can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for -1 CP, regardless of other uses of that stratagem this phase; it does not prevent other units from also using it.

name: Revenant Jet Pack
summary: When this model Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 8" to its Move characteristic until end of phase.

name: Ride the Wind
summary: While this model leads a unit, when it Advances, skip the Advance roll and add 6" to its Move characteristic instead until end of phase.

name: Runes of Battle (Psychic)
summary: Weapons equipped by models in this unit gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Runes of Fortune (Psychic)
summary: When an enemy declares a charge targeting a unit with this ability, subtract 2 from the Charge roll.

name: Sadistic Raiders
summary: At the end of your Command phase, an objective marker this unit or its transport controls within range stays controlled until the opponent's Control Level there exceeds yours.

name: Scattershield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save; on some models, attacks allocated to it also have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: Serpent Shield
summary: Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: SERVANT OF THE WHISPERING GOD
summary: If your army includes this model, it cannot also include any Epic Hero units excluding Ynnari, and vice versa.

name: Shade of Twilight
summary: After this unit shoots, if not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6"; if it does, it cannot charge this turn.

name: Shadow Field
summary: The bearer's invulnerable save cannot be re-rolled; the first time it fails one, the bearer loses its invulnerable save for the rest of the battle.

name: Shadow Hunter
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks by models in that unit get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Shadow of Death (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, its Battle-shock and Leadership tests suffer -1.

name: Shimmershield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Skyfire
summary: When targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem as an enemy Flying unit moves, this model can also shoot up to 3 other Flying enemy units within 24", hitting them only on an unmodified Hit roll of 6.

name: Skyhunter
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against a unit that can Fly get +1 to the Hit roll and +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Skyleap
summary: At the end of the opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range, remove this unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

name: Sonic Destruction
summary: This model's named cannon attacks against a unit get +1 Strength, +1 Armour Penetration, and +1 Damage for each other friendly model of the same type that also hit that unit with the same weapon this phase.

name: Speed of Vaul
summary: When this model Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 9" to its Move characteristic until end of phase.

name: Spirit Mark (Psychic)
summary: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, pick a friendly non-Titanic Wraith Construct unit within 6" and a visible enemy unit; until your next Movement phase that friendly unit's weapons gain Sustained Hits 1 against that enemy.

name: Spiritseer
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Wraith Construct unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Storm of Blades
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Storm of Silence
summary: Attacks this model makes against a Character unit can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Stormblades
summary: At the end of your Command phase, an objective marker this unit controls within range stays controlled until the opponent's Control Level there exceeds yours.

name: Structural Collapse
summary: Attacks this model makes with its named cannon re-roll a Damage roll of 1, or the whole Damage roll instead against a Titanic unit.

name: Superlative Strategist
summary: While this model leads a unit, re-roll Advance rolls for it and re-roll any rolls it makes while performing an Agile Manoeuvre.

name: SUPPORT ARTILLERY
summary: During Declare Battle Formations, this model can join a Guardian Defenders unit, becoming part of it for the rest of the battle and increasing its Starting Strength; the joined unit cannot embark in a transport.

name: Support Weapon
summary: While this model's unit contains another model, this model has a Toughness characteristic of 3 against attacks that target the unit.

name: Sustained Assault
summary: Melee attacks this model makes after a Charge move this turn score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 4+.

name: Swift Demise
summary: Ranged attacks by models in this unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or re-roll the Hit roll entirely against the closest eligible target.

name: Tactical Acumen
summary: While this model leads a unit, after that unit shoots, it can make a Normal move of up to 6"; if it does, it cannot charge this turn.

name: Target Acquisition
summary: After this unit shoots, pick an enemy unit hit by its long rifle attacks; until end of phase that unit cannot claim Benefit of Cover.

name: Tears of Isha (Psychic)
summary: In your Command phase, pick a friendly Wraith Construct unit within 6", once per turn; return a destroyed model to it, or heal a model up to D3 wounds if none were lost.

name: The Bloody-Handed (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Aeldari unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

name: The Path Least Travelled
summary: After deployment and determining first turn, redeploy one eligible Ranger-type unit, optionally placing it in Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal limit.

name: The Scorpion’s Bite
summary: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer gain the Devastating Wounds ability against non-Titanic units.

name: Titan Hunter
summary: Each time this model's ranged attack is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, re-roll a Damage roll of 1.

name: Titanic Advance
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move over non-Titanic models and terrain 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

name: Titanic Agility
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move through models and terrain, entering but not ending within Engagement Range of enemy models.

name: Titanic Strides
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move through non-Titanic models and terrain up to 4" high, or taller terrain at the risk of Battle-shock on a D6 of 1, without ending within Engagement Range.

name: Tormentors
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, enemy units within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Towering Wraith Construct
summary: Each time an opponent targets this model with a Stratagem, they must pay three times that Stratagem's normal Command Point cost.

name: TRAVELLING PLAYERS
summary: Unless stated otherwise, your army cannot include more than one of this model.

name: Treacherous Illusion (Psychic)
summary: Enemy melee weapons gain the Hazardous ability while targeting this model's unit.

name: Unquenchable Resolve
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on a 2+ set it back up at full wounds near where it died, outside Engagement Range.

name: War Construct
summary: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Wave Serpent Shield
summary: Ranged attacks against this model with a Strength greater than its Toughness suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Way of the Blade
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have the Fights First ability.

name: Way of the Shaper (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, Wraith Construct models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

name: Webway Shunt Generator
summary: Once per battle, at the end of the opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range, remove this model and place it in Strategic Reserves.

name: Webway Strike
summary: A friendly Aeldari unit arriving from Strategic Reserves may instead set up wholly within 6" of this Fortification, even within 9" or Engagement Range of enemies; doing the latter counts as a charge, letting it fight this turn.

name: Whirling Death
summary: While this model leads a unit, when it Advances, skip the Advance roll and add 6" to its Move characteristic instead, ignoring vertical distance for that move.

name: Whispering Web
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; until end of turn, friendly Aeldari attacks against it score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

name: Word of the Phoenix (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, in your Command phase roll a D6: on a 2+ return D3+1 destroyed non-Support-Weapon Bodyguard models to that unit at full wounds.

name: Yvraine’s Champion
summary: While this model leads a unit, other Character models attached to that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Battle Focus
summary: Gain Battle Focus tokens by battle size (2/4/6/round) to trigger Agile Manoeuvres on ASURYANI units: bonus Move, Fire Overwatch immunity, ranged Assault on Advance, bigger Pile-in, or bonus reactive moves.

name: Disparate Paths
summary: HARLEQUINS units can be included in your army despite lacking the ASURYANI Faction keyword; your Army Faction still cannot be Harlequins or Ynnari unless stated otherwise.
